reason: Conversation 1 correctly explains up front that E011 means a key is detected as held or covered too long. It gives the right fix of drying the panel and power-cycling at the isolator, and says to escalate to Bosch only if the code recurs. Conversation 2 says sources disagree on what E011 means and lists a temperature sensor as a possible cause, which is unsupported and could mislead. Its paragraphs also run together and are harder to read, although its final advice is sound. Conversation 1 includes a phone number and warranty detail that may not be accurate, but these are minor next to its clearer, correct diagnosis.
